metadata.title: Lawlor's curvature criterion and topologically trivial area-minimizing hypercones of Hsiang type
metadata.abstract: For a closed embedded minimal hypersurface in a unit sphere, we show that the existence of a uniform vanishing angle in Lawlor's criterion suffices for its cone to minimize area. The normal-wedge condition follows from Howard's rolling theorem. We derive explicit curvature bounds and apply them to the reported Hsiang-Sterling curvature estimates for topologically trivial cones. The resulting area-minimizing cones give an affirmative answer to the existence question raised by Ilmanen and White (Camb. J. Math., 2015).

analysis.progressType: 校准判据与面积极小锥
analysis.workSummary: 研究球面内闭嵌入极小超曲面的 Lawlor 曲率判据，以统一消失角推出其锥面积极小。
techniques: Hsiang 型锥的显式曲率估计
analysis.breakthrough: 由滚动定理导出法楔条件，再将显式界应用于已报告的 Hsiang–Sterling 估计，得到拓扑平凡的面积极小锥。
analysis.limitations: 应用依赖所引 Hsiang–Sterling 曲率估计及统一消失角；不能把条件判据误说成任意极小超曲面的锥都面积极小。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 披露 ChatGPT 用于语言、文献检索、符号与代数计算，并依据作者草图指令生成图；图形协助不作为原始数学思想来源。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31341v1 · PDF 第 11 页 AI disclosure

analysis.priorityReason: 联系可计算曲率条件与既有极小锥存在性问题。
